caption:
The queue's biggest year. ERCOT: MW of generation and storage that entered ERCOT's interconnection queue in the year, every status, as LBNL's Queued Up data file records it was 85,405 MW in 2024, the highest of the 21 complete years held; the previous high was 66,858 MW in 2023. Never had so much asked to join the line in one year.

Checked before it was drafted: 19 complete years before 2024; the record period is complete; no gap in the window; it stands 27.7 percent above the previous high (2023).

The claim states a change; it does not say what caused it. LBNL's 2026 edition holds entries through 2025.

Source: lbnl_interconnection_queue, as the ERW holds it. ERW table: lbnl_interconnection_queue.
